topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe my luck. Of all the vast, sprawling expanse of the internet, the person I've grown to appreciate in the digital shadows lives in the same city. It's an unexpected twist, a narrow bridge in a wide, lonely sea. I’ve been piecing together the fragments of our conversations, trying to navigate the new terrain of possibility. Meeting in person feels like stepping into uncharted waters, fraught with uncertainty. The idea of it is overwhelming, yet the thought of not seeing them, of letting this chance slip away, is almost unbearable.
